findings.label: Signal query scales with row count
findings.detail: GET /api/orders/signal now selects every order's id to compute sumId in JS, instead of a constant-cost count(head) + 1-row max. The response to the client is still three integers, but the Supabase-side read grows linearly with the orders table. Negligible at current scale; if the table grows large, move the aggregation into a Postgres RPC (select count(*), max(id), sum(id)) to keep the read constant-size.
